summary: "{\"title\":\"Unit Snapshot: UGC NET Commerce - Business Finance\",\"summary\":\"This document serves as an educational resource for students preparing for the UGC NET exam in Commerce, specifically focusing on Business Finance. It covers key concepts, definitions, theories, and financial management practices essential for understanding the financial operations of a business.\",\"key_points\":[\"Financial management involves planning and controlling financial resources.\",\"Wealth maximization is the primary objective of financial management, replacing profit maximization.\",\"Key functions of financial management include investment decisions, financing decisions, and dividend decisions.\",\"Investment decisions involve selecting assets for investment, while financing decisions pertain to capital structure.\",\"Various sources of finance include equity, debt, and retained earnings.\",\"Different types of bonds and debentures are explained, including plain vanilla bonds, zero coupon bonds, and convertible debentures.\",\"The document discusses capital budgeting, the time value of money, and investment appraisal techniques such as NPV and IRR.\",\"Working capital management is crucial for day-to-day operations, with concepts like gross and net working capital defined.\",\"The document outlines risks associated with overtrading and undercapitalization.\",\"International financial management is introduced, highlighting the complexities of managing finances in a global context.\"],\"entities\":[{\"name\":\"Howard and Uptron\",\"entity_type\":\"Author\",\"description\":\"Defined financial management as an application of general managerial principles to financial decision-making.\"},{\"name\":\"Weston and Brighem\",\"entity_type\":\"Author\",\"description\":\"Defined financial management as harmonizing individual motives and enterprise goals.\"},{\"name\":\"Solomon Ezra & J.
